new_findings.text: There is a one-tick window where the web HUD lies about the stance gate, and it comes from a clamp rather than from the offset. §1t113s0§.as:328 computes the bar fill as '(param1 - 48) / (param2 - 48)', then :329-332 clamps a negative result to 0. The 'cannot change stance' label fires at :336 'if(_loc3_ == 0)', so it shows for every raw Focus value <= 48. The actual gates are strict: §1t99s0§.as:3050 'return this.§1t4469s0§() && this.§1t4414s0§ >= 48;' and :3060 'if(this.§1t4414s0§ < 48) { return; }'. At raw == 48 exactly the bar renders empty and prints the cannot-change-stance string while a stance switch is legal and costs the whole 48 (:3162). A 1:1 recreation must reproduce the clamp, not derive the label from the gate predicate.
